significance: A Vaishnava shrine 13 km from Rameswaram, counted among the 108 Abhimana Kshethrams, and the only structure at Dhanushkodi left standing by the cyclone of 1964. A proposed alignment of the Sethusamudram canal was dropped because it would have required demolishing it.
story: This is held to be where Vibhishana, Ravana's brother, surrendered to Rama's army, and where Rama afterwards crowned him king of Lanka.
